body.p: Upon entry of the present Reply, claims 2-14 will be pending and under consideration.

Claim 1 is canceled herein. Claims 2-14 are newly added herein. Support for new claims 2-14 is found at least in paragraphs [0033] - [0037] of the Specification as-filed. No new subject matter has been added.

The specification stands objected because the title of the invention is missing a letter in front of 'ntravascular'. The Specification is amended to correct this clerical error thereby obviating the objection.

Claim 1 stands rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 112(b), second paragraph, as being indefinite for failing to particularly point out and distinctly claim the subject matter. Claim 1 is canceled herein thereby rending moot the rejection as it applies to that claim.
Claim 1 stands rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 103 as being unpatentable over U.S.

Publication No. 2009/0005675 (hereinafter "Grunwald") in view of U.S. Patent No. 6,662,055 (hereinafter "Prutchi") and further in view of U.S. Publication No. 2014/0142670 (hereinafter "Radhakrishnan"). Claim 1 is canceled herein thereby rendering moot the rejection as it applies to that claim.

Claim 1 stands rejected for non-statutory double patenting as being unpatentable over claim 1 of U.S. Patent No. 11,006,854. Claim 1 is canceled herein thereby rendering moot the rejection of as it applies to that claim.

Applicant respectfully submits that the present application is in condition for allowance. Reconsideration of the application and an early Notice of Allowance are respectfully requested. In the event that the Examiner cannot allow the application for any reason, the Examiner is encouraged to contact Applicant's representative.
